text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Mejiro Bright was being 
interviewed for a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Your Racewear suits you wonderfully. Are 
there any specific details you were 
particularly particular about?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let me see~ As I thought, this skirt 
would be best~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You finished it just as I envisioned, and 
I am ever so grateful~âª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Mejiro Bright talk so happily, I 
was suddenly reminded of the time her 
first racing outfit arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I went with a design like this. How does 
everyone like it~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, it's super good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it suits Bright so well. Puff 
sleeves and a corset skirt—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's so flashy and cute, it's definitely a 
design that wouldn't look good on me at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ that's not true at all~. I think it 
would look lovely on you, Dober, and on 
you too, Ryan-onesama♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: For example, if it were Dober, let me see—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How about a crimson dress accented with 
plenty of lace? I could add a headdress as 
well♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, wait, no, stop it...! There's no 
way something with this many frills would 
look good on me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......Well, yeah, I do think it's cute, 
and if Bright insists on it no matter 
what, then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of clothes would suit 
Sister Ryan~? For instance—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you pair a voluminous ruffled blouse 
with something like a black pinafore 
dress, I'm sure it would look simply 
wonderful on you~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, no...! I'm totally fine without 
that kind of stuff...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Um... It's not that I'm not interested, 
but... Yeah, well..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway!! It's a great racewear that 
really brings out your charm, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That skirt in particular really left an 
impression. Maybe it's because of how 
prominently it uses that vivid green...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it certainly is quite eye-catching, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Truth be told, this skirt was inspired 
by my memories with dear Sister Ryan."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh, with... me...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in my early childhood, I couldn't 
even run around with everyone else, and 
was considered an "inferior student."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"However—Ryan-onesama took my hand back 
then and ran alongside me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Together with someone as far from fast as 
me, running on the training grounds 
forever and ever—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That buoyant feeling I had back then. That 
rush of excitement remains my foundation 
to this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This solid green skirt is the lush green 
scenery of the training grounds where I 
ran with Onee-sama that dayâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's a scenery filled with memories with 
you, Dear Sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day, I have trained 
relentlessly, sharpened my skills 
alongside Dober, and been supported by 
you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And so, she finally reached the point 
where she could don the green and white 
racing silks of Mejiro tradition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Ryan-oneesama. I would like to take 
this opportunity to express my gratitude 
once again."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So that's the kind of thought that went 
into it... Ehehe, maybe that's why the 
skirt left such an impression on me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This skirt, and one more thing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Handed down from Dear Sister, and shared 
between Dober's legs and mine, a symbol of 
our bond—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Bearing my feelings for Sister Ryan upon 
myself, I shall become the light of the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can't wait to see Bright shine in 
that racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I won't lose either, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, Mejiro Bright-san, could you tell 
us about the thoughts and feelings that 
went into designing your racewear?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A special, sentiment. I suppose so... 
............

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Bright hesitate, I couldn't 
just stand by any longer—
choice_data_list: Excuse me, it's time for training...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. That will be all for now. 
Thank you very much for answering my 
questions. This will make for a great 
article."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. About that interview from 
earlier—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why did you cut off the final question 
midway through?
choice_data_list:
Because I didn't think now was the time to 
talk about it.
Because I wanted to cherish your memories.
Because I wanted to cherish your memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why did you cut off the final question 
midway through?
choice_data_list:
Because I didn't think now was the time to 
talk about it.
Because I wanted to cherish your memories.
Because I wanted to cherish your memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer-sama. It seems you were 
thinking the exact same thing as me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I felt those memories should be kept 
secret. Until the day I can stand tall and 
proud as an Umamusume carrying the Mejiro 
family name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Because we are still on our journey, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I look forward to your continued 
companionship on our path to the heights 
of glory~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking to the future together with Mejiro 
Bright, we renewed our vows for what lies 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ You truly understood how I was 
feeling, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No... and not just today, either. You have 
always stayed by my side and supported my 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Let us continue hand in hand, walking 
forward at our own pace together."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I look forward to working with 
you once again~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My bond with Mejiro Bright grew even 
deeper.
